messages:
nora: quick flag from today's UI pass — the deep-ink surface looks slick but two issues: heatmap spikes don't read as urgent and inline SQL syntax in the query inspector is losing token separation on mobile. short pass pls. :mag:

gabe: saw that too. for heatmap i think a diverging ramp will make spikes pop, but we need to pick an amber that's accessible on midnight. i'll mock two ramps: diverging (teal -> neutral -> amber) and a boosted sequential (higher chroma amber).

lydia: mobile issue: inline tokens collapse when font-size drops. strings and booleans look almost identical because our boolean hue is very close to string hue after compression. we should make booleans cooler and slightly desaturate strings.

kai: small chart nit — the heatmap legend is tiny on mobile (8px swatches). bump to 12px and increase label weight by 100. also add a keyboard focus state for legend items (outline + slight lift).

nora: good. gabe, can you also try adding a 1px stroke between stacked heatmap bands (very subtle) so edges are visible when colors are similar?

gabe: yup. i'll upload frames. design-bot, please create token drafts for both ramps and legend size change.

design-bot: created frames /design/deep-ink-heatmap-v2 and token drafts tokens/deep-ink-heatmap.json. diverging midpoint uses #2f3436, amber start #ffb36b, adjusted to #ff9a40 for accessibility candidate. legend.swatch = 12px. stroke = rgba(0,0,0,0.06).

lydia: small copy suggestion: panel title currently "Errors" -> propose "Errors 1 last 24h" for clarity when date range changes. also add tooltip explaining what counts as an "error" (5xx + parser failures).

kai: accessibility question: will the stroke increase readability for colorblind users? or do we need an additional marker?

a11y-bot: running contrast & accessibility checks on token draft...
- amber `#ff9a40` vs panel bg: 4.3:1 6a8 (below 4.5 for small elements)
- legend swatch + small label (12px) vs panel bg: 4.6:1 44d (passes)
- mid-tone (`#2f3436`) vs panel bg: 6.8:1 44d
- subtle stroke (rgba(0,0,0,0.06)) between bands: improves perceptual separation but does not affect numeric color contrast tests. recommendation: darken amber slightly to `#ff8a20` OR increase swatch size for very small markers.

nora: let's try darkening amber to `#ff8a20`. gabe, change that in the tokens and re-export frames. also add a non-color marker option (tiny dot) that can be toggled for anomaly mode so colorblind users can enable a shape overlay on spikes.

gabe: updated tokens & frames: amber -> `#ff8a20`, added anomaly-dot overlay option (dot size 6px, fill same amber, stroke 1px `#0b0d0f @ 56%`). pushed to /design/deep-ink-heatmap-v3.

a11y-bot: re-checking...
- amber `#ff8a20` vs panel bg: 4.8:1 44d (passes)
- anomaly dot (6px) vs panel bg: 4.0:1 6a8 (below 4.5 for very small markers) Recommendation: increase dot to 8px or add 1px stroke (stroke applied) to reach 4.5:1.

lydia: increase dot to 8px (agree) and keep stroke. also update query inspector tokens: boolean -> cooler `#2fc9b0` and string -> slightly desaturated `#4fe0c2` so tokens separate even at small sizes. run contrast check on those.

a11y-bot: checking token updates...
- boolean `#2fc9b0` vs code.bg: 4.6:1 44d
- string `#4fe0c2` vs code.bg: 4.4:1 6a8 (just under) Suggest increase string luminance by ~3% to hit 4.5:1.

lydia: bump string luminance slightly to hit threshold. kai, can you also test the inline token rendering at 12px and 14px on Android Chrome and iOS Safari? mobile compression tends to shift perceived color.

kai: will run both and attach screenshots. also will add keyboard focus spec for legend items: focus ring `#2bd9aa` 2px solid + 4px offset, and a press state that toggles anomaly-dot.

gabe: small copy tweak request from product: rename panel label "Error heatmap" -> "Error heatmap 1 count" when counts are enabled, else show "Error heatmap 1 density". i'll wire that into the tooltip state.

design-bot: token PR opened: tokens/deep-ink-heatmap-vfinal.json with amber `#ff8a20`, anomaly-dot 8px, legend swatch 12px, boolean/string token adjustments. PR description includes mobile-check todo and copy note for the panel label.

a11y-bot: final pass pending mobile screenshots. once mobile checks pass, recommend merging tokens and adding a small note in the theming doc: "Use anomaly-dot overlay for colorblind-friendly heatmap exploration."

nora: plan: kai runs mobile checks and uploads screenshots by tomorrow 11am PT, lydia will tweak string luminance by +3% and gabe will ensure the anomaly-dot is toggleable in the component. design-bot will merge tokens after a11y-bot clears. thanks team! :sparkles:

(attachments: /design/deep-ink-heatmap-v3.png, token-pr-heatmap.diff, mobile_screenshot_android.png)
